fuse_gtest_files: run the script to fuse Google Test source code into a single .h and .cc file
fuse_gtest_h: create a fused gtest.h header file by recursively inlining all gtest header includes
fuse_gtest_all_cc: build a fused gtest-all.cc source file by recursively inlining all gtest source includes
validate_gtest_root_dir: verify that a given directory contains valid Google Test root files before processing
validate_output_dir: check that the output directory is valid and prompt to overwrite existing files
